description: All analyses use 'label_used_for_experiments' column. This includes both original UniProt annotations and recovered labels.

label_recovery_policy.method: Protein name parsing and subfamily mapping were used to recover labels for sequences initially lacking kinome group annotations.
label_recovery_policy.name_regex_source: Regular expression matching on protein names (e.g., 'CAMK' in name -> CAMK group)
label_recovery_policy.mapping_source: Subfamily to major group hierarchical mapping

experiment_usage: All clustering, supervised classification, and retrieval experiments use 'label_used_for_experiments' column exclusively.
